subject: meetings.records

entries.definition: A held or scheduled session anchored to exact recording and transcript relationships independently from CRM or provider database layout.
A Meeting-scoped person identity that remains distinct from CRM contact identity until a separate governed resolution establishes a link.
A Meeting-grounded statement of intended work that remains review material until explicitly retained or dispositioned into a Task or Project workflow.
A transcript-grounded Meeting document with exact source attribution, limitations, and separately governed downstream handoffs.

limitations: This vocabulary defines portable Meeting meaning only; it grants no transcript access, provider, approval, execution, or health authority.
CRM, Project, and Task relationships are optional typed resource identities rather than required Context dependencies.
